title: A diameter gap for irreducible compact symmetric spaces of fixed rank
summary: We prove that, for every positive integer $r$, the positive normalized diameters of isometric quotients of simply connected irreducible compact Riemannian symmetric spaces of rank $r$ have a uniform positive lower bound. The bound is independent of the dimension and of the acting group, which need not be connected. For the higher-dimensional Grassmannian families, we obtain an explicit bound for positive-dimensional acting groups by constructing nonconstant invariant functions of bounded trigonometric degree.
